name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (category level)
licenseNote: The Trust Services Criteria are copyrighted by the AICPA. AEGIS references the criteria series identifiers only, at category level; every title and summary is original AEGIS wording describing the objective and is not the text of the criteria. A SOC 2 report can only be issued by a licensed CPA firm; nothing in AEGIS is or substitutes for one.
description: The common criteria and the four additional categories of the AICPA Trust Services Criteria at series level, with the AEGIS records that could support an organization's own SOC 2 preparation.

controls.title: Control environment
controls.summary: Leadership sets integrity and ethical values, oversight, structure, competence and accountability for the system's controls.

controls.title: Communication and information
controls.summary: Relevant, quality information about objectives, responsibilities and controls is communicated internally and to external parties.

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.summary: Objectives are specified, risks to them identified and analysed, fraud considered and changes that affect controls assessed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary: Controls are evaluated on an ongoing basis and deficiencies are communicated and remediated in time.

controls.title: Control activities
controls.summary: Control activities, including those over technology and enforced through policies and procedures, are selected and deployed to address risks.

controls.title: Logical and physical access controls
controls.summary: Access to systems, data and facilities is restricted to authorised people and services, credentials are managed and removed, and data is protected in transit and against unauthorised disclosure.

controls.title: System operations
controls.summary: Configuration changes, vulnerabilities, anomalies and security events are detected, evaluated, responded to and recovered from, with incidents managed under a plan.

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorised, designed, tested, approved and implemented under control.

controls.title: Risk mitigation
controls.summary: Business disruption risks and risks from vendors and business partners are identified, assessed and managed.

controls.title: Availability
controls.summary: Capacity, environmental protections, backups and recovery are managed so the system is available as committed.

controls.title: Confidentiality
controls.summary: Information designated confidential is identified, protected and disposed of as committed.

controls.title: Processing integrity
controls.summary: Processing is complete, valid, accurate, timely and authorised, with inputs, processing and outputs controlled and records kept.

controls.title: Privacy
controls.summary: Personal information is collected, used, retained, disclosed and disposed of according to notice and consent, with access, quality, monitoring and enforcement in place.
